params.descricao: Auto pack attack/defend quando packmate luta contra Vampiro

_metadata.texto_original: Buries-the-Dead bears many scars across her throat from her battles against Leeches. She may automatically pack attack or defend when a packmate fights a Vampire. Draw a combat card when this occurs. Rivalry: Vampires.
